top_signals.title: US Conducts Fresh Strikes as Iran War Escalates
top_signals.summary: The US launched a new wave of strikes targeting Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps after attacks on American military bases in the Middle East, deepening a conflict that is rapidly spreading across the region. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Oil giant Shell smashes expectations as profits more than double in second quarter
top_signals.summary: The bumper result comes as energy majors receive a profit boost from soaring fossil fuel prices amid the Iran war.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Anglo American Posts Profit Jump on Record Copper Prices
top_signals.summary: Anglo American Plc posted a jump in profit and raised its dividend as it joined rival miners in cashing in on record copper prices.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: SpaceX faces House Energy Committee demand to tour its AI data centers in Memphis
top_signals.summary: The ranking member of the House Committee on Energy is demanding SpaceX records and a tour of its data centers and power plants in and around Memphis.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: House-passed defense bill includes controversial US-Israel tech measure
top_signals.summary: The House-passed defense bill includes a measure to encourage co-development and co-production between the U.S. and Israeli defense industrial bases.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Inside India newsletter: Meta's clout in the world's largest democracy is surging — inviting scrutiny
top_signals.summary: Meta Platforms has strengthened its influence on India as Gen Z protesters widely relied on Instagram to raise their concerns against the Modi government.

top_signals.title: BMW Cost Cuts, New Models Underpin Carmaking Returns
top_signals.summary: BMW AG’s profit from carmaking in the second quarter was slightly better than expected after the German company reduced spending and benefitted from strong demand for its new models.
